cues: When x is small, x squared is tiny and x cubed tinier still, so the first two or three terms already give an excellent value.
One point zero two to the power one third: one, plus point zero two over three, minus point zero zero zero four over nine.
The next term is about a millionth and cannot touch the fifth decimal place.
One point zero zero six six two.
